scientific_integrity.computational_support: The included dependency-free script passed 96157 deterministic numerical assertions; its finite tests are explicitly not an infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Closed-form reduction to a one-variable log-odds secant quotient, derivative-sign global optimization, monotone rare-event root bracketing, and exact two-state covariance.

scientific_limitations: Applies only to irreducible reversible two-state frozen generators and the single-state indicator output; it is not a general finite-network or driven-protocol theorem.
The balanced case has limiting nontrivial sharpness only as the instantaneous state tends to equilibrium.
Broader implicit functional-inequality coverage remains possible; independent mathematical and priority validation are not performed.
title: Sharp finite-amplitude lag–dissipation constant for binary reversible Markov networks
